question: ______ is an initiative launched in India with the plan to inculcate hygiene, sanitation, effective waste management, and infection control in public health facilities.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kayakalp**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__

__
 
• Recently the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has conferred 5th National Kayakalp awards to Public and Private Health Facilities for high standards of Sanitation and Hygiene.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• About:

 
 
• Those District Hospitals, Subdivisional hospitals, Community Health Centres, Primary Health Centres, and Health & Wellness Centres in the public healthcare system who have achieved high levels of cleanliness, hygiene, and infection control were recognized and felicitated with awards.
 
 
 
• Objectives:
 
 
• To promote cleanliness, hygiene, and infection control practices in public healthcare facilities, through incentivizing and recognizing such public healthcare facilities that show exemplary performance in adhering to standard protocols of cleanliness and infection control
 
• To inculcate a culture of ongoing assessment and peer review of performance related to hygiene, cleanliness, and sanitation.
 
• To create and share sustainable practices related to improved cleanliness in public health facilities linked to positive health outcomes
